<h2>About this site</h2>
<p>Sirius Blog keeps my working notes: the mathematics behind machine learning, and summaries of the research I am reading. Notes are written in Chinese with English terms on first mention, and every block is labelled as a definition, theory, inference step or result.</p>
<h2>How it is built</h2>
<p>Written in Markdown, rendered with Quarto, and published to GitHub Pages on every push to <code>main</code>.</p>
